race.comment: BE QUIET (5) had been struggling in town earlier this prep but responded well to the drop in grade last start when beaten narrowly over this distance at Tuncurry. Has been to Kembla twice and won both times. Great chance to enhance that record. DANCES WITH HOOVES (2) is first-up from a short spell for the local Price stable. Opened last prep with a placing in a $50k quality sprint over this distance at Tamworth. Not seen at the trials since her last run three months ago. Betting a key indicator. ME ME (10) goes well here over 1200m as a rule and with a bit of weight relief today can run a bold race. PELEUS (6) a big watch fresh on his home track from the middle draw.
